facts.steel:
Steel
How to obtain

Starting house supplies and finite home patches; mine by hand or use a powered Excavator. Regional extraction sites use powered Excavators.

Used by
Shot magazine: 2 steel per craft.
Frame: 2 steel per craft.
Board: 1 steel per craft.
Arc lamp construction: 4 steel · recruit the Lamplighters at their shelter.
Excavator construction: 10 steel.
belt construction: 1 steel.
inserter construction: 1 steel.
Assembler construction: 40 steel.
Gun turret construction: 15 steel.
Lamp construction: 1 steel.
pole construction: 1 steel.
Generator construction: 30 steel.
Floodlight construction: 10 steel · recruit the Electricians at their shelter.
Big pole construction: 4 steel · recruit the Electricians at their shelter.
Substation construction: 50 steel.
Supply chest construction: 10 steel.
Track construction: 1 steel · restore the second-area tram station.
Tram stop construction: 10 steel · restore the second-area tram station.
Tram construction: 20 steel · restore the second-area tram station.
Wall construction: 2 steel.
Underground belt construction: 5 steel.
Priority splitter construction: 5 steel.
Mixer construction: 20 steel · recruit the Concrete crew at their shelter.
Barricade construction: 2 steel · recruit the Concrete crew at their shelter.
first tram station restoration: 30 steel delivered locally.
Paid manual and workshop repairs, disabled-core recovery and radio precision upgrades consume steel.
Move and store

Carry or store in the house, Supply chests, station inventories and truck cargo. Belts and inserters move items; operating trams carry configured freight. Transfers do not create items.

facts.magazine:
Shot magazine
How to obtain

Starting house supplies; handcraft magazines near the house using carried steel and copper, or automate them in an Assembler.

Shot magazine · Available

2 steel + 1 copper → 1 magazine every 6s

Assembler · 100 kW · nominal 10/min. Supply, power and output space limit actual production.

Starting Assembler plans

Used by
